run_EpochBasedRunner: run the EpochBasedRunner with data loaders and a workflow specifying train and val epochs
train_EpochBasedRunner: train a model epoch by epoch using the EpochBasedRunner train method with a data loader
val_EpochBasedRunner: validate a model using the EpochBasedRunner val method with a data loader without gradient computation
save_checkpoint_EpochBasedRunner: save a model checkpoint with optional optimizer state and metadata using save_checkpoint method
run_iter_EpochBasedRunner: run a single training or validation iteration on a data batch using the run_iter method
